2014_spells.far-step.effectSummary: Teleport up to Self to a space you can see
2014_spells.far-step.fullDescription: Using 1 bonus action, on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again. You teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. On each of your turns before the spell ends, you can use a bonus action to teleport in this way again; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
